We met at my parents' flat on Sunday to decide how to cover Yiayia's care home place from January. My cousin Thanasis said he can do the Tuesday visits instead of money. Nobody has agreed yet who books the respite week in October, so that stays open.

My brother Alexandros Michaelides said he can pay 300 euros a month. Afterwards he told us he was made redundant from the shipping firm in August and his severance runs out in December, so the 300 euros is only guaranteed until then. He asked us not to mention it to our mother, and if he finds work before December he will raise his share to 450.

Our mother will pay 650 euros from her pension and wants the remaining gap shared equally between the three of us. I said I would check whether the welfare office gives any top-up before we commit.

The next meeting is on the 14th of December; Aunt Marina Petrides will join by video.
